author: Hubert Kowalski
name: harmonic_armature_guide
description: Adds a 'harmonic armature' (14-line) composition overlay to the list of available cropping and framing guides.
description-extensive: This adds a classic compositional overlay, known as the harmonic armature or 14-line armature, to the guides you can display while composing or cropping. It helps you line up the important elements of your photo along proven diagonal lines for a more balanced result. Simply pick harmonic armature from the guide options when you want it. No extra software is needed.
